chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Mahzīyār narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Fuḍayl, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: “May I be your ransom, our camel driver passed by us and did not stop at al-Muʿarras.”
So he said: “You must return to it.” So we returned to it.

key_terms.الْمُعَرَّسَ: al-Muʿarras, the resting place referred to in the report
key_terms.جَمَّالَنَا: our camel driver or caravan handler
key_terms.لَا بُدَّ: it is necessary; there is no alternative

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام say about missing a stop at al-Muʿarras?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام instructed the questioner and his companions to return to al-Muʿarras after they had passed it without stopping. It indicates the importance of observing this prophetic resting place and treating the stop there as something not to be omitted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3146 - It is narrated by Ali ibn Mahziyar from Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ibn al-Fudhayl, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan (as): "May I be your ransom, our camel driver passed us by and did not stop at al-Mu'arras.

Imam (as) said: 'You must return to it.'
So we went back to it."
